During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. ❌ ① forced — 'is forced to be'의 수동태 과거분사로 적절
❌ ② adding — 전치사 by 뒤 동명사(by adding)로 적절
✅ ③ tripling — 원문은 tripled. 앞에 has가 있으므로 현재완료(has + 과거분사) 구조입니다. 'since 1969(1969년 이후)'라는 표현과도 현재완료가 어울립니다. triple을 과거분사 tripled로 써야 하며, tripling은 완료형을 만들 수 없어 틀립니다 ←정답

det.tip: World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969 — 현재완료 has + 과거분사(tripled)

During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969, and the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled; we are feeding and watering our fields more than ever, and our crops are loving it. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also excited the attention of certain agricultural undesirables. Because farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water relative to the natural land that surrounds them, they are desired as <u>luxury real estate</u> by every random weed in the area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 luxury real estate가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 잡초에게 농경지가 '호화 부동산'이라는 것은, 양분과 물이 가득해 잡초가 자라기에 더없이 좋은 매력적인 서식지라는 비유적 의미
det.analysis:
❌ ① 비싼 값에 사고팔 수 있는 넓은 농경지: 부동산의 문자적 의미(매매)로, 잡초에게 좋은 서식지라는 비유를 놓침
✅ ② 잡초가 번성하기에 더없이 좋은, 양분이 풍부한 서식지: 농경지가 양분·물이 가득해 잡초가 몰려들 만큼 살기 좋은 곳이라는 비유에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ 농부들이 소유하고 싶어 하는 값비싼 땅: 원하는 주체는 농부가 아니라 잡초(weed)임
❌ ④ 자연 그대로 보존해야 할 소중한 야생 지역: 농경지는 인위적으로 비옥해진 땅이지 보존 대상 야생지가 아님
det.tip: desired as luxury real estate by every random weed — 잡초에게 최적의 서식지

ch: 비싼 값에 사고팔 수 있는 넓은 농경지
잡초가 번성하기에 더없이 좋은, 양분이 풍부한 서식지
농부들이 소유하고 싶어 하는 값비싼 땅
자연 그대로 보존해야 할 소중한 야생 지역

questions.passage: The soil of a farm field is forced to be the perfect environment for monoculture growth. This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of <u>both</u>. World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969, and the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled; we are feeding and watering our fields more than ever, and our crops are loving it. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also excited the attention of certain agricultural undesirables. Because farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water relative to the natural land that surrounds them, they are desired as luxury real estate by every random weed in the area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 both가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 'supplying exactly the right amount of both'에서 both는 앞서 공급 대상으로 언급된 두 가지, 즉 '영양분(비료)과 물'을 가리킨다
det.analysis:
✅ ① 비료(영양분)와 물: 앞 문장에서 '비료 형태의 양분과 관개를 통한 물'을 공급한다고 했으므로, both는 이 두 가지를 가리킴 ←정답
❌ ② 엔지니어와 작물 과학자: 이들은 공급을 돕는 주체이지 공급 대상이 아님
❌ ③ 토양과 잡초: 공급되는 대상이 아님
❌ ④ 농부와 소비자: 본문의 공급 대상과 무관
det.tip: adding nutrients ... and water ... supplying exactly the right amount of both

questions.passage: The soil of a farm field is forced to be the perfect environment for monoculture growth. This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969, and the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled; we are feeding and watering our fields more than ever, and our crops are loving it. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also excited the attention of certain agricultural undesirables. Because farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water relative to the natural land that surrounds them, they are desired as luxury real estate by __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 양분이 풍부한 농경지가 호화 부동산으로 '그 지역의 모든 잡초'에게 탐난다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① a team of careful crop scientists: 과학자는 농부를 돕는 주체이지 농경지를 탐내는 대상이 아님
❌ ② the largest farms in the country: '가장 큰 농장들'은 탐내는 주체가 될 수 없음
✅ ③ every random weed in the area: 원문 일치. 앞서 '농업 불청객'의 관심을 끈다고 했으므로, 농경지를 호화 부동산처럼 탐내는 것은 '그 지역의 모든 잡초'입니다 ←정답
❌ ④ the workers who built the field: '밭을 만든 일꾼들'은 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: desired as luxury real estate by every random weed in the area

ch: a team of careful crop scientists
the largest farms in the country
every random weed in the area
the workers who built the field

questions.passage: The soil of a farm field is forced to be the perfect environment for monoculture growth. This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969, and __________; we are feeding and watering our fields more than ever, and our crops are loving it. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also excited the attention of certain agricultural undesirables. Because farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water relative to the natural land that surrounds them, they are desired as luxury real estate by every random weed in the area.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
"전 세계 관개 능력은 거의 두 배가 되었다."
[조건] (1) almost, capacity, doubled, for, global, has, irrigation, the를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 전 세계 관개 능력은 거의 두 배가 되었다 = the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled
det.analysis: 주어는 'the global capacity for irrigation(전 세계 관개 능력)'으로, 핵심 명사 capacity가 단수이므로 현재완료의 조동사는 has입니다. '거의'를 뜻하는 부사 almost는 has와 과거분사 doubled 사이에 넣어 'has almost doubled(거의 두 배가 되었다)' 순으로 배열합니다
det.tip: the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled — 현재완료(has + almost + doubled)

questions.wa: the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled
accept: the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled

questions.passage: This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also __________ (excite) the attention of certain agricultural undesirables.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 'have also __________'는 현재완료(have + 과거분사)이므로 excite → excited
det.analysis: these luxurious conditions have also __________ (excite) — 앞에 have가 있으므로 현재완료(have + 과거분사)입니다. 부사 also는 have와 과거분사 사이에 들어간 것이며, 동사 excite를 과거분사 excited로 바꿔 '자극해 왔다'는 뜻을 만듭니다
det.tip: have also excited the attention — 현재완료 have + 과거분사(excited)

questions.passage: The soil of a farm field is forced to be the perfect environment for monoculture growth. This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969, and the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled; we are feeding and watering our fields more than ever, and our crops are loving it. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also excited the attention of certain agricultural undesirables. Because __________ relative to the natural land that surrounds them, they are desired as luxury real estate by every random weed in the area.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
"농경지는 영양분과 물이 가득하다."
[조건] (1) and, are, farm, fields, loaded, nutrients, water, with를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 농경지는 영양분과 물이 가득하다 = farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water
det.analysis: '~이 가득하다'는 'be loaded with ~'로 표현하는 수동태입니다. 주어 farm fields(복수) 뒤에 are + 과거분사 loaded를 쓰고, 전치사 with 뒤에 가득 찬 대상 nutrients and water를 이어 붙입니다
det.tip: farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water — 수동태 be loaded with

questions.wa: farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water
accept: farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water

questions.passage: The soil of a farm field is forced to be the perfect environment for monoculture growth. This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. World usage of fertilizer has tripled since 1969, and the global capacity for irrigation has almost doubled; we are feeding and watering our fields more than ever, and our crops are loving it. Unfortunately, these luxurious conditions have also excited the attention of certain agricultural undesirables. Because farm fields are loaded with nutrients and water __________, they are desired as luxury real estate by every random weed in the area.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 되도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (8단어)

[단어] land / natural / relative / surrounds / that / the / them / to
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 그것들(농경지)을 둘러싼 자연 토지에 비해
det.analysis: 'relative to ~'는 '~에 비해'라는 뜻의 전치사구입니다. 뒤에 비교 대상인 the natural land(자연 토지)를 놓고, 이를 꾸미는 관계대명사절 that surrounds them(그것들을 둘러싸는)을 붙여 'relative to the natural land that surrounds them' 순으로 배열합니다. 관계대명사 that의 동사는 단수 선행사 land에 맞춰 surrounds입니다
det.tip: loaded with nutrients and water relative to the natural land that surrounds them

questions.wa: relative to the natural land that surrounds them
accept: relative to the natural land that surrounds them

questions.passage: The soil of a farm field is forced to be the perfect environment for monoculture growth. This is achieved by adding nutrients in the form of fertilizer and water by way of irrigation. During the last fifty years, engineers and crop scientists have helped farmers become much more efficient at supplying exactly the right amount of both. questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
"그리고 우리 작물들은 그것을 아주 좋아하고 있다."
[조건] (1) and, are, crops, it, loving, our를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 그리고 우리 작물들은 그것을 아주 좋아하고 있다 = and our crops are loving it
det.analysis: 등위접속사 and로 앞 절과 연결한 뒤, 주어 our crops(우리 작물들) + 현재진행형 are loving(좋아하고 있다) + 목적어 it(그것을) 순으로 배열합니다. 상태동사 love가 진행형으로 쓰여 '한창 좋아하고 있다'는 생생함을 나타냅니다
det.tip: our crops are loving it — 현재진행형(are loving) + 목적어(it)

questions.wa: and our crops are loving it
accept: and our crops are loving it
